what: Pressing the two-line burger (two 1px lines at ±5px) makes a background-color panel cover the whole screen, fading in place in .6s, while the two burger lines gather to the center and tilt ±45° into an X (.3s). Pressing again, Esc, or a link inside the panel retracts it over the same duration — a quiet fullscreen menu where the panel only fades and never moves

options.dur: Length of the panel fading in and out (s), default .6 — 0 for instant
options.line: Length (seconds) at which the burger line bends into an X, default .3
options.--fx-line-w · --fx-line-gap: Burger line length and gap (via style), default 50px · 5px
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Burger button (child) — the lines are drawn by ::before and ::after
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Covering panel (child) — put the logo, menu and button inside
options.fx:open · fx:close: Events fired from the element on open and close

from.where: shared.js .kt-burger and .kt-menu — original .hnavi_btn (line transition all .3s) and .spnavi (transition all .6s)
